title: Christopher Radko Large Egg Salt Shaker #E72 - Ceramic
categoryName: Collectibles:Kitchen & Home:Kitchen Tools & Gadgets:Salt & Pepper Shakers
descriptionText:
Spice up your Easter table with this Christopher Radko Large Egg Salt Shaker. Made of high-quality ceramic material, this salt shaker is the perfect addition to your collection of kitchen tools and gadgets. Its unique egg shape and large size make it a standout piece that is sure to impress your guests.

This salt shaker is part of the Christopher Radko brand, known for its exceptional quality and attention to detail. It comes complete with a set that includes a salt shaker, making it an ideal choice for any occasion. Add a touch of whimsy to your table setting with this charming egg salt shaker.
